svg.title: Before: the rejected two-card launcher
svg.desc: The launcher as implemented and rejected on 2026-08-30. Two stacked equal-weight cards 460px wide on an ember canvas: "Start a Project" with a single-line goal input and a Continue button, and "Or open an existing folder" with a path input and an Open button. It shares no header wordmark, card geometry, typography, or visual language with the binding reference.
